sql: SELECT firm_name, city FROM firms WHERE state='CA' ORDER BY firm_name, firm_id

SELECT f.firm_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(r.classification='Class I')/COUNT(*),1) AS pct FROM firms f JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id GROUP BY f.firm_id, f.firm_name ORDER BY pct DESC, f.firm_name, f.firm_id
SELECT recall_number, julianday(report_date)-julianday(recall_initiation_date) AS d FROM recalls WHERE classification='Class II' AND termination_date IS NULL ORDER BY d DESC, recall_number LIMIT 1
SELECT f.state, COUNT(*) AS c, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls),1) FROM firms f JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id GROUP BY f.state ORDER BY c DESC, f.state

SELECT r.classification, ROUND(AVG(julianday(r.report_date)-julianday(r.recall_initiation_date)),1) FROM recalls r LEFT JOIN classifications c ON c.classification=r.classification GROUP BY r.classification ORDER BY c.severity_rank IS NULL, c.severity_rank
SELECT e.event_id, e.product_category, COUNT(r.recall_number) FROM events e LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.event_id=e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.product_category ORDER BY e.event_id

SELECT state, firm_name FROM (SELECT f.state, f.firm_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, f.firm_name, f.firm_id) AS rn FROM firms f JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id GROUP BY f.firm_id) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY state

SELECT recall_number, classification, d FROM (SELECT recall_number, classification, julianday(center_classification_date)-julianday(recall_initiation_date) AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY classification ORDER BY julianday(center_classification_date)-julianday(recall_initiation_date) DESC, recall_number) AS rn FROM recalls) WHERE rn=1
SELECT product_category, ROUND(100.0*SUM(classification IN ('Class I','Class II'))/COUNT(*),1) AS p FROM recalls GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY p DESC, product_category
SELECT f.state, COUNT(DISTINCT f.firm_id), COUNT(r.recall_number) FROM firms f LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE f.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.state ORDER BY f.state

SELECT r.recall_number, r.classification, julianday(r.report_date)-julianday(r.center_classification_date) AS d FROM recalls r LEFT JOIN classifications c ON c.classification=r.classification WHERE julianday(r.report_date)-julianday(r.center_classification_date) > (SELECT AVG(julianday(r2.report_date)-julianday(r2.center_classification_date)) FROM recalls r2 WHERE r2.classification=r.classification) ORDER BY c.severity_rank IS NULL, c.severity_rank, d DESC, r.recall_number

SELECT r.product_category, ROUND(100.0*SUM(r.classification='Class I')/COUNT(*),1) AS p FROM products p JOIN recalls r ON r.recall_number=p.recall_number GROUP BY r.product_category ORDER BY p DESC, r.product_category
